name_en: Yau's solution of the Calabi conjecture (Ricci-flat corollary)
canonical_claim: For every compact Kahler manifold X whose real first Chern class vanishes, and every Kahler class kappa on X, there exists a Kahler metric g whose Kahler form represents kappa and whose Ricci curvature vanishes.
